uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
2438-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.
2438-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

262-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least four counters on it.
262-4687-5479.description:
Activate Elemental Mastery by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte three times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping three lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {2}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1170-3698-5131-7650--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-7650--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

851-4365-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2528-5088-6797-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2528-5088-6797-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

2829-3490-4455-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2829-3490-4455-7426.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

216-1618-2440-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings
216-1618-2440-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
216-1618-2440-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1409-1418-5423.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve both Swashbuckler Extraordinaire triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4677-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1369-3043-7086.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
1369-3043-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Axebane Guardian.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Axebane Guardian's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Axebane Guardian's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Axebane Guardian's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

1183-2178-4061.description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dalakos triggers, untapping Dalakos.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

149-1284-4831.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Cacophodon.
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Cacophodon ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2308-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-5789.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

280-1479-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-6662.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

394-856-2099-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4094-5223.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-2457-4094-5223.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1874-3490-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1874-3490-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2558-5226-5687-5692.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

864-1987-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
864-1987-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

618-2292-2732.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Prowling Geistcatcher with haste.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, the nontoken and token Prowling Geistcatcher's first abilities trigger.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Prowling Geistcatcher token.
When the token Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1978-2392-2625-4659-4768.notablePrerequisites:
Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
Silverskin Armor attached to Kibo.
1978-2392-2625-4659-4768.description:
Activate Kibo by tapping it, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
When the Banana enters the battlefield, Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Banana, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat.

512-4050-4241.notablePrerequisites: Halo Fountain does not have summoning sickness.
512-4050-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Citizen, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2.

678-2438-2452.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing itself.
Carrion Feeder dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, doing nothing since Carrion Feeder is not on the battlefield.
Cast Carrion Feeder from your hand by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1651-3883-4857.description:
Activate Temple Bell, drawing each player a card.
For each card your opponent would have drawn, create a Treasure token instead.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures token, untapping Temple Bell.
Repeat

2060-3233-4120-4498.description:
Cast Saving Grace by paying {1}{W}.
Saving Grace enters the battlefield attached to Crystalline Crawler, triggering itself, causing all damage that would be dealt to you or permanents you control this turn to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Saving Grace's ability redirects damage to Crystalline Crawler, which results in at least three +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least once by removing at least one +1/+1 counter from it, adding at least {B}.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2427-3573-4125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2427-3573-4125.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
